events.body:
## Context

`src/cron.js:39` does `fields[4].replace(/\b7\b/g, "0")`, which turns `1-7` into `1-0` and then fails the `lo > hi` check, so `parseCron("0 0 * * 1-7")` throws `bad value in "1-0"` (so does `5-7`). The comment says "0 or 7 = Sunday".

## What to do

1. Parse the day-of-week field with range [0,7], then map 7 to 0 in the resulting set.
2. Add cases to the "cron matching" test in `test/cron.test.js`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `1-7`, `5-7` and `*/7` parse
- [ ] `1-7` matches every day
- [ ] Existing tests pass

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-cron
```
